description: This source file contains internal diagnostic utility functions for the PDFsharp library, including exception handling and error reporting related to PDF parsing and content reading.

classes.name: ParserDiagnostics
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling parser-related errors such as exceptions for unexpected characters, tokens, and stream end issues.

classes.name: ContentReaderDiagnostics
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling content reading errors including exceptions for unexpected characters, numbers out of range, and stream issues.

methods.name: ThrowParserException
methods.description: Throws a PdfReaderException with a specified message, optionally with an inner exception.

methods.name: HandleUnexpectedCharacter
methods.description: Handles an unexpected character in PDF stream, throwing an exception with diagnostic information.

methods.name: HandleUnexpectedToken
methods.description: Handles an unexpected token in PDF stream, throwing an exception with diagnostic information.

methods.name: CannotFindEndOfStream
methods.description: Reports an error when the end of a PDF stream cannot be found.

methods.name: ThrowContentReaderException
methods.description: Throws a ContentReaderException with a specified message, optionally with an inner exception.

methods.name: ThrowNumberOutOfIntegerRange
methods.description: Throws an exception when a long value is out of integer range for PDF content.
